officialTitle: Pembrolizumab plus Chemotherapy for Squamous Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: we randomly assigned, in a 1:1 ratio, 559 patients with untreated metastatic, squamous NSCLC

clinicalQuestion: Does adding pembrolizumab to carboplatin plus paclitaxel or nab-paclitaxel improve OS and PFS in first-line metastatic squamous NSCLC?

pico.intervention: Pembrolizumab plus carboplatin and paclitaxel or nab-paclitaxel (4 cycles), then pembrolizumab
pico.comparator: Placebo plus carboplatin and paclitaxel or nab-paclitaxel
pico.outcomes: Dual primary: OS and PFS. Safety

arms.label: Pembrolizumab-combination
arms.regimen: Pembrolizumab plus carboplatin and paclitaxel or nab-paclitaxel
arms.dosing: Pembrolizumab 200 mg for up to 35 cycles; chemotherapy for the first 4 cycles
arms.doseSourceQuote: to receive 200 mg of pembrolizumab or saline placebo for up to 35 cycles; all the patients also received carboplatin and either paclitaxel or nanoparticle albumin-bound [nab]-paclitaxel for the first 4 cycles

arms.label: Placebo-combination
arms.regimen: Placebo plus carboplatin and paclitaxel or nab-paclitaxel

publications.title: Pembrolizumab plus Chemotherapy for Squamous Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer.
publications.label: Primary (interim) analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: After a median follow-up of 7.8 months, the median overall survival was 15.9 months (95% confidence interval [CI], 13.2 to not reached) in the pembrolizumab-combination group and 11.3 months (95% CI, 9.5 to 14.8) in the placebo-combination group (hazard ratio for death, 0.64; 95% CI, 0.49 to 0.85; P<0.001).

The median progression-free survival was 6.4 months (95% CI, 6.2 to 8.3) in the pembrolizumab-combination group and 4.8 months (95% CI, 4.3 to 5.7) in the placebo-combination group (hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.56; 95% CI, 0.45 to 0.70; P<0.001).

safety.description: Adverse events of grade 3 or higher
safety.sourceQuote: Adverse events of grade 3 or higher occurred in 69.8% of the patients in the pembrolizumab-combination group and in 68.2% of the patients in the placebo-combination group.
Discontinuation of treatment because of adverse events was more frequent in the pembrolizumab-combination group than in the placebo-combination group (13.3% vs. 6.4%).

strengths: OS benefit consistent across PD-L1 levels
limitations: Short median follow-up at primary analysis
Crossover may affect later OS estimates

clinicalImplications.text: Established pembrolizumab plus carboplatin-taxane as a first-line standard for metastatic squamous NSCLC, irrespective of PD-L1 expression.

tumourBoardPearl.text: KEYNOTE-407 is the squamous counterpart of KEYNOTE-189 — taxane-carboplatin backbone instead of pemetrexed.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 30280635. Later updates not ingested.
